[Supreme Guideline]: Paste the paths and click Execute

🛠️ Steps 1~5: Standard Batch Modification Project (Suitable for multi-file or large mod pack creation)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[1. Deep Search & Autofill]: Scan the game's 0000 files to generate a mapping table (CSV Dictionary) of scrambled filenames (Hash) and real card names.
You can also use this feature to quickly extract card ID txt files for mod files.

[2. Find Files]: Use the mapping table to search for cards, and copy the corresponding game files for centralized management.
It can smartly read the txt file generated on the previous page, and you can switch to the fast original game files to over-frame feature (click to switch mode).
If you want to make your own mods over-frame, please use Pendulum & Over-Frame Art Post-Processing.
In case you didn't know, right-clicking can also move selected items.
Visual filtering allows you to visually check if you've picked the right images.

[3. Extract Data]: Extract 2D textures from files and keep original backups.
You can also generate a CSV (copied from the parent CSV).
You might notice there seem to be two backup folders, it's by design.

[4. Change Card Art]: Inject the images you modified in "Modified Card Art (you can rename it)" into the card files.
For card art naming, please keep the [ID prefix and underscore], you can name whatever you want after it.
For example: "12345_CallItWhateverYouWant.png"

[5. Pack Mod]: Automatically organize modified encrypted files into a folder structure matching official paths, for easy application or sharing.
Pack your files!


⚡ Advanced Performance & Automated Scheduling
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[6. Smart Chained Execution]: 1-Click auto-chained execution of all steps from 2 to 5 above, completely saving the time of manual step-by-step operations.
But you still need to fill in your paths.


🎨 Visual Effects & Advanced Card Face Beautification
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[7. Pendulum & Over-Frame Art Post-Processing]: Automatically fix square pendulum art proportions / Automatically apply over-frame templates for your cards (click processing mode to switch).
Pendulum images are for square card arts; it will pad a transparent frame at the bottom to prevent distortion in-game.
The over-frame template will automatically place your image in the center and crop it to an 11:16 ratio.

[8. Quick Single Card Mod]: Skip creating a project, directly search for a specific card, select a new image to replace the original game file with 1 click.
To replace multiple card arts, it is highly recommended to use the features in the upper half. This feature is very limited but simple.

[9. Over-Frame Card Register]: Modify the over-frame card whitelist (of_card_asset). Write the card ID into the game's registry to allow it to break frame limits.
You can jump here from the second page search (or auto-fill from txt) to find the cards you want.

[10. Graphical Browser]: Provides thumbnail viewing of 2D assets like playmats, coins, icons, sleeves, and lobby wallpapers, allowing direct transfer of IDs to the extraction list.


🔧 Mod Maintenance, Rescue & Virtual Management
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[11. Mod Stream Fixer]: When a major game update invalidates old mods, directly transplant texture streams of old mods into the latest official game files.
This feature theoretically works, but if Konami changes the file storage format, it can't be saved.

[12. Virtual Mod Manager]: Uses system symbolic link (Symlink) technology. 1-Click enable or restore multiple mods without installation or taking up space.
Requires administrator privileges.
Very convenient for testing mods.

[13. Settings & Appearance]: Customize program accent colors, background images, and transparency, and adjust sidebar tab order and names here.
Most global settings are located here. Remember to click save settings after making changes!
